# SCI-JINC v0.1 Profile-Name And Supersession Disposition r0.3

Status: incorporated into an implementation-blind Stage B author draft;
final Stage B acceptance and freeze remain pending

Prepared: `2026-08-29`

## Disposition

The immutable Registry identity remains
`SCI-JINC:jinc_map_contribution@1`. No renamed profile, alias, or
supersession record is invented.

The canonical human-readable term is:

> JINC upstream-occurrence admission (Registry identity
> `SCI-JINC:jinc_map_contribution@1`)

Narrative and requirements use that semantic term. They do not routinely call
the decision "map contribution."

## Semantic Boundary

The immutable identity authorizes only upstream-occurrence consideration. It
does not authorize rounded-center admission, destination-pixel membership,
cancellation support, arithmetic contribution, numerical adequacy, or bundle
publication. Producer availability and every downstream gate remain separate.

The shared definition and requirements `SCI-JINC-REQ-035`--`036` carry this
boundary. Predictions `SCI-JINC-PRED-032` and `SCI-JINC-PRED-034` use the
canonical term without changing their identifiers.

This disposition makes no implementation, validation, achieved-fidelity,
readiness, or production claim.
